one_month_reasoning: No earnings in the window (Q3 FY27 report expected early December 2026, outside 10/30). The stock just absorbed two shocks: -14.5% after Q2 (early Sept) and -18.5% on 9/28 when CEO CJ Desai left for Meta, then +7% on 9/29 after Investor Day reaffirmed guidance, raised long-term targets and brought back ex-CEO Ittycheria as interim. In-window items: sell-side notes digesting Investor Day (mostly supportive, Piper called the drop overdone), possible CEO-search headlines, Meta enterprise-platform news (a competitive-narrative risk), mid-October CPI and big-tech/hyperscaler earnings in late October that move cloud-consumption names. Short-term regularity after a guidance-reaffirmed overreaction is mild partial reversal, offset by post-shock momentum; I set the median slightly above spot (~$358) with ~16.5% one-month log vol (between realized 71%/3.5 ~20%, which is inflated by the two jumps, and a calmer ~14%).

fair_value.method: Blend of EV/NTM sales (Sept-2027 NTM revenue ~$4.1B x 8.0x + ~$3.1B net cash, /85.6M diluted = ~$419) and P/E (Sept-2027 NTM non-GAAP EPS ~$9.8 x 42x = ~$412).

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: NTM revenue at Sep-2027 ~$4.1B x 8.0x = EV $32.8B; + net cash ~$3.1B; / 85.6M diluted shares

inputs_detail.derivation: Investor Day 3-year target of >20% total growth with Atlas mid-20s; Q2 growth 30% but Q3 guide implies deceleration; I use low-20s, haircut for leadership transition and Postgres share-shift evidence (sources 6,7).
FY28 ~$3.64B (3.01 x 1.21), FY29 ~$4.37B; NTM from Oct-2027 weighted ~2/3 FY29 + 1/3 FY28 remainder ~ $4.1B.

Current EV ~ $26.3B (80.6M shares x $356 - $2.4B cash) on NTM revenue ~$3.35B = ~7.9x; Sergey's substack cited ~11.4x forward EV/S in Jan-2026 as near historical median. Hold ~8x given rate of growth slightly lower and transition risk.
Add ~ $0.7B FCF (Q2 FCF $137.6M run-rate, rising); no convertible debt outstanding per 10-Q liabilities.
Q2 non-GAAP net income $162.6M / non-GAAP EPS $1.90 = 85.6M; basic 80.56M outstanding at 8/28/26; ~1-2% annual dilution offset by buyback.
Investor Day target of 100-200 bp annual margin expansion; FY27 midpoint op income $626M / $3.01B = 20.8%.
FY28 op income ~$812M, FY29 ~$1.04B; net income ~0.89x op income (FY27 guide ratio); /86.5-87.5M shares -> FY28 ~$8.35, FY29 ~$10.6; NTM blend ~$9.8.
Fool noted ~63x forward / 53x next-year pre-selloff; today ~49x NTM. Growth ~20%+ with rising margins supports a compressed but premium 40-45x; midpoint 42x.

bear.story: CEO search drags or an outsider disappoints; Atlas decelerates to low-20s as Postgres/vector-in-RDBMS erodes new workloads (developer survey share slipping), sales execution loosens without a permanent leader; EV/sales compresses to ~5x NTM $3.9B.

base.story: Ittycheria steadies the ship, a credible permanent CEO named in H1 2027; revenue grows ~21% with 150 bp margin expansion; stock re-rates modestly as transition fear fades, near fair value ~$400-415.

bull.story: AI/agentic workloads (Atlas Infinite, Agent Engine, Voyage embeddings) keep Atlas at ~28-30%, total growth mid-20s, margins expand faster; multiple recovers toward 10-11x sales, matching top sell-side targets ($525-565).

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$250 (about -30%, under the post-CEO-shock low region and near the 52-week low of $215.68 zone) the stock would be pricing ~5.5x EV/sales, which only makes sense if Atlas consumption growth has broken below ~20% or a guidance cut/key-talent exodus followed the CEO departure, not ordinary volatility.

Durability of Q2's 30% growth given Q3 guide steps down sequentially
reasoning: Facts: Q2 FY27 revenue $771.8M (+30%), Atlas +29%, non-GAAP op margin 24%, FCF $137.6M, $2.4B cash, no converts; FY27 guide raised to $2.99-3.03B rev / $6.39-6.58 EPS; Q3 guide $756-761M implies deceleration, which drove a ~14.5% post-print drop. On 9/28 the CEO left for Meta after <1 year (-18.5% to $334.68); guidance was reaffirmed, ex-CEO Ittycheria returned as interim, and 9/29 Investor Day raised long-term targets (>20% growth, 100-200 bp/yr margin expansion, 80-100% FCF conversion), stock +7% to ~$356-361. Alternative lane: HN developer thread and a databases newsletter lean negative on developer mindshare (Postgres 55.6% vs MongoDB ~26% and slipping in SO survey; Atlas pricing complaints; MongoBleed CVE and extortion campaign) but also note enterprise lock-in; Revelio shows postings up 4.4% but hiring velocity down (352/mo vs 460) and flat headcount - consistent with margin discipline, not distress; Blind/Glassdoor mixed on quiet restructuring. Substack writers (Sergey, LTSI) highlight record Atlas net-new ARR and 120% NDR. X was not fetched; no relevant prediction markets found. SEC and data APIs were rate-limited, so research was limited to ~15 queries. Valuation: EV/sales and P/E both land ~$412-419; blended fair value $415 (+17%). Scenario mean ~$392. I use a lognormal with median ~$385 and ~50% annual vol (below the 71% realized, which is inflated by two event jumps, but above a typical large-cap given a CEO vacuum and high multiple), trimming extreme tails slightly. P(>=356) ~0.56.
